target_or_objective: Binary classification: at_risk = 1 if final_result in {Withdrawn, Fail}, else 0. Population: students still enrolled at the cutoff day (25% of the module-presentation length).
split_strategy: Chronological by module-presentation: train = 2013B+2013J, validation = 2014B, test = 2014J (src/make_split.py).
fit_boundary: All learned preprocessing is fitted on training data only.
numerical_features: early_tma_mean_score (TMAs due AND submitted by cutoff, non-banked)
categorical_features: imd_band (labels normalized, missing kept as 'Missing' category)

excluded_features.reason: target proxy revealing withdrawal; used only for the DQ-04 population rule with unregistrations known by the cutoff

excluded_features.feature: assessment scores due or submitted after cutoff (incl. all Exams and CMAs outside allowed set)
VLE clicks after cutoff / whole-course click totals

excluded_features.reason: result carried over from a previous presentation, not earned in this run's early window
encodes the split boundary (train presentations never appear at test time); cohort effects discussed at Model Gate

preprocessing_steps.name: build early-window features from raw tables (cutoff filter from src/config.py)
normalize imd_band labels; encode missing imd_band as 'Missing'
median imputation + missing-indicator for date_registration; indicator + neutral fill for early-TMA features (DQ-03/DQ-05)
standard scaling for linear models only

model_ready_output.train_shape: 11309 rows x split membership (features built at Model Gate)
